display.purpose: One dominant hero number or control-room readout per screen.

headline.purpose: Major KPI values and primary dashboard totals.

title.purpose: Card and section titles in dense workspaces.

body.purpose: Default UI copy, table cells, drawer content, and operational descriptions.

label.purpose: Badges, KPI labels, compact labels, and uppercase metadata.

shadows.name: repouso
shadows.purpose: Default cards and resting raised panels.

shadows.name: flutuante
shadows.purpose: Dropdowns, popovers, select menus, and hover cards.

shadows.name: modal
shadows.purpose: Dialogs, sheets, drawers, and blocking overlays.

motion.name: ease-padrao
motion.purpose: Default color, border, shadow, transform, and opacity transitions.

motion.name: duracao-lenta
motion.purpose: Larger entrance, panel, and composed transitions.

rules: Use color only when it carries operational meaning.
Write role tokens, not raw numbers.
Prefer drawers for long entity editing.
Do not install UI kits with competing theme systems.
Portal components must inherit CRM2 tokens from [data-cf2-theme].

componentSnippets.card: ...
